description:
[Deterministic entity classification. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Classifies corporate entities into 'Essential Entity' vs 'Important Entity' under Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS2) based on sector, headcount FTE, and financial turnover/balance sheet thresholds, computing supervisory regime and statutory fine exposure (up to 10M€ or 2% of global turnover).
Usage: Use this tool to determine corporate NIS2 scope and governance duties. For penetration testing scope under DORA, use 'tlpt_threat_led_pentest_scope'.
Returns: JSON object with { entityCategory: 'ESSENTIAL' | 'IMPORTANT' | 'OUT_OF_SCOPE', supervisoryRegime: string, maxStatutoryFineEur: number, statutoryObligations: string[] }.

balanceSheetTotalEur.description: Annual balance sheet total in EUR

isSoleNationalProviderOrDnsTld.description: Whether company is a critical DNS/TLD registry or sole national provider

sector.description: Primary statutory sector of activity under NIS2 Annex I and II
